name: barbell snatch balance
description: A drill where you drop under a bar on your back into an overhead squat. It builds overhead stability and speed.
instructions: Rest the bar on your upper back and take a wide snatch grip.
Dip a short way and drive up.
Drop into a squat while pressing the bar overhead.
Catch it with locked arms and your chest up.
Stand up with control and return the bar to your back.
